interpretation_rules.CANON_COMPARATOR_NOT_DESTINATION: Existing canon is a **comparator**, not a destination.
interpretation_rules.DATE_DOES_NOT_UNLOCK: The date alone does **not** unlock a technology, create capacity, give every agent access, establish profitability for another process, cause migration or colonize a location.
interpretation_rules.SITE_SPECIFIC: Site specificity matters: a proven process at one site creates transferable knowledge, not capacity at other sites.
interpretation_rules.UNKNOWN_NOT_ZERO: Missing quantities remain `UNKNOWN` / null, not zero.

milestones.capability_change_md: 1I/ʻOumuamua is discovered. Its interstellar trajectory and nongravitational acceleration become enduring scientific anomalies; neither proves artificiality at the time.
milestones.notes_md: ʻOumuamua discovered; anomaly not proof of artifice

milestones.capability_change_md: **First Look** launches on a high-energy chemical/gravity/Oberth architecture to overtake 1I.
milestones.notes_md: First Look chemical/gravity/Oberth mission launch; **mission**, not invention or a lift-cost datum

milestones.capability_change_md: Permanent orbital and Lunar industry expands; durable Mars settlement becomes a serious civilizational project.
milestones.notes_md: Permanent orbital/lunar industry grows; no autonomous-build date or required simulation outcome

milestones.capability_change_md: Permanent orbital and Lunar industry expands; durable Mars settlement becomes a serious civilizational project.
milestones.notes_md: Durable Mars settlement becomes a serious **project**, not guaranteed success

milestones.capability_change_md: First Look performs a high-speed remote encounter at hundreds of AU. Imaging, lidar and tomography establish manufactured internal geometry. Extraterrestrial technological intelligence becomes verified science.
milestones.notes_md: First Look imaging/lidar/tomography verifies manufactured geometry in fiction

milestones.capability_change_md: **Second Chase** launches for rendezvous using heavy launch/gravity assist/Oberth plus fission-electric cruise and terminal braking.
milestones.notes_md: Second Chase heavy launch/Oberth plus fission-electric mission; not commercial transport

milestones.capability_change_md: Practical high-performance fusion propulsion transforms Solar-System travel. Torch ships emerge.
milestones.notes_md: High-performance fusion torch emerges; distinct from stationary fusion power

milestones.capability_change_md: Second Chase rendezvous with 1I. Human physical access begins; the later-named **Access Cascade** begins or is triggered in close temporal association with entry.
milestones.notes_md: 1I physical access and associated Access Cascade; no intact alien drive supplied

milestones.capability_change_md: Alien superheavy-parent forensic evidence redirects a major human nuclear/materials research race toward the A≈299, Z≈115 neighborhood.
milestones.notes_md: Superheavy-parent samples narrow human search toward A≈299/Z≈115, not synthesis instructions

milestones.capability_change_md: Torch technology becomes mundane infrastructure. Mars, Belt and outer-system industry expand into a mature spacefaring civilization.
milestones.notes_md: Torch commonplace; Mars/Belt/outer industry expands; no fleet, population, mine output or forced development

milestones.capability_change_md: Human laboratories synthesize Mc-299 in relevant experimental quantities; the result is initially disappointing.
milestones.notes_md: Human experimental Mc-299 synthesis, initially disappointing

milestones.capability_change_md: Human researchers identify the useful metastable Mc-299m state; host-lattice / NRE architecture becomes the central engineering problem.
milestones.notes_md: Human useful metastable state discovered; host lattice remains engineering problem

milestones.capability_change_md: Tiny reproducible excitation-correlated relational residuals become controlled subluminal metric effects.
milestones.notes_md: Laboratory sub-c metric control, not a ship

milestones.capability_change_md: Metric drives progress from laboratories to government and corporate vessels. They remain expensive, rare and strategic.
milestones.notes_md: Scarce government/corporate sub-c metric vessels; no universal speed/cost/fleet

milestones.capability_change_md: A deeper-topology breakthrough turns nonlocal translation from theory into experiment.
milestones.notes_md: Deeper-topology experimental breakthrough (fiction only)

milestones.capability_change_md: First successful unmanned interstellar translation.
milestones.notes_md: First unmanned interstellar translation; not commercial service

milestones.capability_change_md: First successful crewed interstellar translation.
milestones.notes_md: First crewed translation; not mass migration

milestones.capability_change_md: First Tau Ceti crewed surveys identify and then verify the independent **Reef** technological lineage.
milestones.notes_md: Separate archaeological lineage discovered; not automatic technology transfer

milestones.capability_change_md: First crewed Epsilon Eridani campaign verifies the independent **Kite** technological lineage. Campaign begins with three known technological lineages, no living alien civilization, and a still-tiny interstellar frontier.
milestones.notes_md: Third line verified in campaign; not simulation endpoint

milestones.basis_uncertainty_md: [R01]; regulator's 25-flight allowance is **not** operating cadence. High uncertainty on economics.
milestones.capability_change_md: High-cadence, economically reusable *heavy orbital launch*; **sustained service**, not first launch
milestones.threshold_gate_md: Reused flight hardware with repeated campaigns, verifiable full-life cycle cost and delivered payload, permitted launch sites, production/turnaround capacity; evaluate Earth surface-to-orbit separately from lunar landing

milestones.basis_uncertainty_md: [R02]; NASA identifies subsystem immaturity and late-2030s/2040s opportunities; 2050 is our margin, not NASA schedule.
milestones.capability_change_md: Operational **megawatt-class nuclear-electric spacecraft**; mission-proven
milestones.threshold_gate_md: Integrated reactor, conversion, power distribution, electric propulsion, heat rejection, lifetime, flight safety and mission budget

milestones.basis_uncertainty_md: [R03,R05,R09]; multi-module scale-up is inference. Location-specific and highly contingent.
milestones.capability_change_md: Reliable **MW-scale delivered electricity** to one off-world industrial facility; sustained operation
milestones.threshold_gate_md: Installed generation may be modular solar/fission/hybrid; storage, distribution, radiators, nights/eclipses, spare parts and power demand. A 40-kW demonstrator alone fails MW threshold.

milestones.basis_uncertainty_md: [R04,R05]; ITER 2039 is experiment, **not** a forecast for this 2060 date. Very speculative.
milestones.capability_change_md: First sustained **net-electric fusion generating station**; engineering demonstration, not cheap worldwide energy
milestones.threshold_gate_md: Net exported electricity accounting for station auxiliaries, endurance, heat/materials, fuel cycle and maintenance; stationary and shipboard fusion remain separate technologies

milestones.basis_uncertainty_md: [R06,R07,R09]; cross-body scale-up extrapolation, not commercial mine.
milestones.capability_change_md: Sustained robotic lunar extraction **pilot**, verified usable product and recurrent operation
milestones.threshold_gate_md: Characterized deposit, excavation, beneficiation/process, power, equipment survival and controlled product assay; resource survey alone fails

milestones.basis_uncertainty_md: [R06–R09]; 2060 author assumption; no globally guaranteed ISRU market.
milestones.capability_change_md: Continuous off-world extraction **and refining** at useful industrial throughput
milestones.threshold_gate_md: Measured grade and mass balance, power, separation/refining yield, consumables, repair, product quality, customers and throughput

milestones.basis_uncertainty_md: [R06–R09] indirect engineering analogues ONLY; no research source predicts profitability or this year. High speculation.
milestones.capability_change_md: Economically operating **asteroid-resource enterprise**; sustained enterprise
milestones.threshold_gate_md: Positive economics including full capital, prospecting, transport, processing, financing and risk against an actual local buyer; one sample return or grant-funded demo fails

milestones.capability_change_md: Routine off-Earth manufacture of **specified useful replacement parts**
milestones.threshold_gate_md: Qualified feedstock, dimension/tolerance test, repeat batches, onsite machines/energy, installation and repair; not full electronics or all spares

milestones.basis_uncertainty_md: [R08,R09]; cost and degree of local content remain open.
milestones.capability_change_md: Local production of **major structural and industrial components**
milestones.threshold_gate_md: Industrial plant, processed local materials, QA/metrology, qualified joints/loads, repeatability, energy, tooling and certification

milestones.basis_uncertainty_md: [R08,R09]; technological field trials are not 2045 predictions.
milestones.capability_change_md: Reliable **autonomous lunar infrastructure construction**; repeatable practical use
milestones.threshold_gate_md: Robots build and verify functional pads/berms/roads or equivalent, site prep, power, communications, repair and accountable QA; simulated regolith printing alone fails

milestones.basis_uncertainty_md: [R08,R09]; definition and date are authored; not total economic self-sufficiency.
milestones.capability_change_md: Expansion of infrastructure using **predominantly locally produced construction materials**
milestones.threshold_gate_md: Measured local mass share >50% **for designated construction materials only** (scenario operational definition, not canon); still account for imported tools, chips and specialty materials

milestones.basis_uncertainty_md: [R09–R11]; present robots/AI do not prove this space-integrated outcome.
milestones.capability_change_md: Uncrewed industrial outpost operates **months autonomously**; demonstrated sustained operation
milestones.threshold_gate_md: Defined task envelope, local decisions, remote exception handling under latency, uptime, energy, repair strategy, security and abort capability

milestones.basis_uncertainty_md: [R10,R11]; AI expert survey is opinion, not industrial forecast. Does **not** imply consciousness/personhood or full labor automation.
milestones.capability_change_md: Broad adaptable machine management of **complex remote industries**; practical task-bounded deployment
milestones.threshold_gate_md: Measured reliability across mining/manufacturing/logistics/maintenance tasks, embodied tools and material stocks; fails if only software planning works

milestones.capability_change_md: Small inhabited outpost supports **infrequent consumables resupply**; sustained operation
milestones.threshold_gate_md: Measured water/air closure, stored or partly grown food, life-support uptime, spares/repair and emergency supplies over a declared mission duration; imported equipment allowed

milestones.basis_uncertainty_md: [R13]; no NASA 2070 date. Not full food security or habitat independence.
milestones.capability_change_md: Small community produces **most consumed food calories locally**; sustained measured operation
milestones.threshold_gate_md: Locally produced share >50% of consumed kcal over a complete year (authored definition), nutritional adequacy, crops/microbes, light/power, nutrients, water and contingency stocks

milestones.basis_uncertainty_md: [R14,R15]; NASA relay programs are real, 2035 is our broad-coverage extrapolation.
milestones.capability_change_md: Reliable **lunar relay and navigation service** supports sustained autonomous industry
milestones.threshold_gate_md: Verified coverage of named service region, uptime, PNT accuracy, interoperable users, DTN, bandwidth/latency and cost; no magical Moon-wide coverage

milestones.basis_uncertainty_md: [R16,R17]; 2070 is conjectural; shielding already reduces exposure and must not be falsely dated as new.
milestones.capability_change_md: Clinically validated additional **radiation-risk countermeasures** for long-duration residence
milestones.threshold_gate_md: Longitudinal evidence of materially lower specified risks under named radiation dose/environment, independent of already possible shielding; access, ongoing treatment and residual risk measured

milestones.basis_uncertainty_md: [R16,R17]; **extreme uncertainty**; no human evidence supports this date or universality. No automatic birth/population effect.
milestones.capability_change_md: Demonstrated **multigenerational biological viability** in a specified off-world environment; scientific qualification
milestones.threshold_gate_md: Observed reproductive, developmental and health outcomes across sufficiently followed generations; separate artificial gravity, partial gravity, radiation and selected cohorts; no inference from one birth

milestones.capability_change_md: **2090 — optional moderate *first-jurisdiction recognition* anchor**, as floated in the prior scenario assessment. It is an expressly **author-created social-history hypothesis, not an empirically supported technological forecast** and not a mandatory event in the simulation. It neither creates synthetic persons nor establishes consciousness, sentience, industrial capability, universal rights, demographic growth or a globally uniform legal regime. An institutional agent must actually enact recognition; cognition/instantiation, substrate, compute, embodiment, legal personhood and non-person task-equivalent capacity remain separate states. If no such actor acts, the date passes without change. [S0,S1 §10.2,S4,R11].
milestones.notes_md: Projection-generated stable ID; source defines no milestone ID.

milestones.capability_change_md: First operational high-performance **fusion torch**
milestones.threshold_gate_md: Ship propulsion, not net-electric grid fusion; fuel, **separate remass**, radiator/heat, plant manufacture and maintenance; no fleet auto-spawn [S1–S2]

milestones.capability_change_md: Useful metastable **Mc-299m laboratory identification**
milestones.threshold_gate_md: Human synthesis, experimental metrology and qualified host-lattice work; never assumes 1I provided a complete recipe or useful hardware [S1–S2]

milestones.capability_change_md: Repeatable controlled **subluminal metric experimental effect**
milestones.threshold_gate_md: Qualified material, energy/heat, control and metrology; not a working ship [S1–S2]

milestones.capability_change_md: First scarce operational **subluminal metric vessel**
milestones.threshold_gate_md: Valid environmental certification, energy, Mc inventory, control/thermal limits and **explicit arrival-state matching**; no FTL or instant Solar communication [S0–S3]

milestones.capability_change_md: First successful **unmanned interstellar translation**
milestones.threshold_gate_md: Energy, finite qualified lattice, topology metrology, compact domain, local ordinary propulsion; not crew rating, route network, mass freight or independent FTL messaging [S1–S3]
